svg.title: Multi-GPU batches
svg.desc: Image and video batches share whole files through one queue. Each selected GPU runs a full pipeline with its own session and buffers. A CUDA build uses CUDA on every selected NVIDIA GPU. An OpenCL build uses OpenCL on every selected GPU, including mixed vendors. Images load and save in the background. Videos have a decode loop and an encode thread per worker. Detection returns image correlations or one CSV per video. Eigen uses one CPU worker. When only one video remains, an idle GPU can start one backup attempt. Only the first complete output is published, the other attempt stops and discards its temporary file. Final-video acceleration is on by default and can be disabled. Image batches do not start backup attempts.
svg.text: Whole files from one queue, each selected GPU runs its own pipeline

g.text: Each free worker takes the next file
Saved images, videos or detection results

svg.text: One backend per build, images overlap loading and saving, videos have a separate encode thread.
*Detection skips encoding, Eigen uses one CPU worker, CPU decoding and encoding share CPU time.

g.text: Stop the other attempt, discard its file

svg.text: Final-video acceleration keeps one result, image batches do not start backup attempts.
